primitives.name: ApproximationChain
primitives.statement: There are maps q_i:X_(i-1)->X_i and observables f_i:X_i->R.
primitives.operational_definition: A finite sequence of spaces, maps, and real-valued observables.

primitives.name: StageResidualBound
primitives.statement: Each stage residual is bounded by a nonnegative epsilon_i.
primitives.operational_definition: A declared uniform bound per stage.

primitives.name: SensitivityBound
primitives.statement: Downstream maps may have nonnegative Lipschitz factors L_i.
primitives.operational_definition: A declared Lipschitz or sensitivity bound.

definitions.name: TotalResidualBudget
definitions.statement: The additive stage budget is the sum of epsilon_i.

definitions.name: PropagatedResidualBudget
definitions.statement: Errors obey e_(i+1)<=L_i e_i+delta_i and are propagated through later sensitivities.

claims.statement: A k-stage observable approximation has total error at most the sum of its per-stage residual bounds.
Zero residual at every stage implies exact observable descent through the composite map.
An L-Lipschitz post-processing map multiplies an input error bound epsilon by at most L.
For e_(i+1)<=L_i e_i+delta_i, the propagated bound is the inherited product term plus each local residual times all later sensitivity factors.
Small local or initial residuals alone do not guarantee a small final residual when repeated dynamics amplify discrepancies.
Useful effective physical models can expose a compositional proof-carrying error budget whose predicted residual envelope contains observed model discrepancy in a declared domain.

observables.name: StageResidual
observables.definition: Absolute discrepancy introduced at one approximation stage.

observables.name: PropagatedResidualBudget
observables.definition: Worst-case final discrepancy after sensitivity-weighted propagation.

falsifiers.condition: Produce a chain satisfying all declared stage residual bounds whose total observable discrepancy exceeds their sum.
Produce nonnegative L_i and delta_i satisfying the recurrence but violating the stated closed-form bound.

metadata.purpose: Formalize compositional error budgets for repeated effective descriptions.
